records.DataSource: User birthdate plus the device local calendar date; local calendar arithmetic
records.KnownLimitations: Compares the birthdate with the device local calendar date only; there is no second-date input. Total days are whole calendar days computed from UTC day indexes, so daylight-saving changes do not shift them. Total hours are those calendar days multiplied by 24, not elapsed civil hours. For a 29 February birthdate, the anniversary in a non-leap year is treated as 1 March. Heartbeats, breaths and hours slept are fixed textbook averages (80/min, 16/min, 8 h/day), not measurements.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + Age/BMI source contract + Age/BMI behavioural browser contract

records.DataSource: User height and weight; local BMI arithmetic
records.KnownLimitations: Adult screening ratio only; not valid for children or teenagers and not a diagnosis. Does not account for muscle mass, build, age, sex, pregnancy or ethnicity. Metric height 50-300 cm and weight 2-500 kg; imperial height 1-9 ft plus 0-11 in and weight 5-1000 lbs, enforced in script rather than by the input attributes alone. Category is decided on the unrounded ratio; the displayed value is rounded to one decimal, so a value shown as 25.0 can still be classified Normal.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + Age/BMI source contract + Age/BMI behavioural browser contract

records.KnownLimitations: The route remains disabled until implementation, runtime, privacy, accessibility, and output behavior complete production certification.
records.UnavailableReason: The page's only rate source is a hard-coded, undated table of 15 currency pairs embedded in the page script (src/tools/converters/currency-converter/index.html, const exchangeRates), while the page markets itself as "real-time exchange rates" over "150+ currencies". Unknown pairs fall through to `|| 1`, which converts at parity instead of failing. Certifying it would require one of two things, and neither is available: (a) a live source covering those pairs — the site's only certified FX source, api/live-data.js resource=exchange, derives rates from the TCMB daily XML and therefore serves TRY, USD and EUR only; or (b) restricting the tool to those three currencies, which would duplicate the already CERTIFIED /tools/finance/live-exchange/ and fail the UniqueUtility criterion. The route is therefore held closed rather than shipped with invented numbers.
records.UnavailableContainment: Verified against the production build: dist/tools/converters/currency-converter/index.html contains no exchangeRates table, carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">, and serves the fail-closed unavailable surface. The invented rates never reach a visitor.
records.UnblockPath: Either extend api/live-data.js resource=exchange with a provider that publishes the additional pairs and wire the page to it with visible provider, timestamp and fallback labelling; or re-scope the page to a manual-rate converter in which the visitor supplies the rate their bank quotes and the page performs only the arithmetic. Both are product decisions, not defects to patch.

records.DataSource: User input; browser BigInt integer arithmetic
records.KnownLimitations: Supports signed whole integers in bases 2, 8, 10, and 16 only. Fractions and fixed-width two's-complement representations are not supported; browser BigInt support is required.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + canonical regression suite

records.KnownLimitations: Division-based ratio mode rejects a zero total. Displayed decimal results are rounded to two places.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + canonical regression suite

records.DataSource: User input; local Roman numeral arithmetic
records.KnownLimitations: Standard notation only: 1-3999 in both directions. Numbers must be entered as digits with no separators, signs or decimal part. Roman input must be in canonical subtractive form (IV, not IIII); non-canonical spellings such as IIII or IC are refused rather than guessed. Vinculum (overbar) notation for 4000 and above is not supported.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + Roman numerals behavioural browser contract

records.KnownLimitations: Double-precision floating point: results are rounded for display and very large or very small values are shown in exponential form. Functions are sin, cos, tan, log (base 10), ln, sqrt and power, with pi and e as constants. Angles follow the DEG/RAD toggle. Domain errors are refused rather than approximated: tan at 90 degrees plus multiples of 180, log or ln of zero or a negative number, the square root of a negative number, and division by zero all report the reason instead of a number. There is no complex-number, matrix, statistics or equation-solving support, and history holds the last 50 calculations for the current page visit only.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + scientific calculator behavioural browser contract

records.DataSource: Browser Intl/IANA timezone database for the selected date
records.KnownLimitations: Supports the 17 listed IANA zones. Historical and future accuracy depends on the timezone database shipped with the browser. Ambiguous and nonexistent daylight-saving local times are rejected rather than guessed.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + canonical regression suite

records.DataSource: User inputs; local conversion constants and temperature formulas
records.KnownLimitations: Displayed results are rounded to six decimal places; the tool covers its listed units only and performs no external lookup.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + canonical regression suite

records.DataSource: User input plus the device clock and time zone; local date arithmetic
records.KnownLimitations: Seconds and milliseconds only: a magnitude above 9,999,999,999 is read as milliseconds and the reinterpretation is stated on screen; any remainder below one second is dropped. Input must be a whole number, so decimals and trailing characters are refused rather than truncated. Timestamps outside the ECMAScript date range (about 275,760 years either side of 1970) are refused. Date-to-timestamp reads the picker value as a local time on the visitor's device, using that device's current time zone and daylight-saving rules. The relative time uses fixed 30-day months and 365-day years and is labelled approximate; leap seconds are not modelled, as Unix time does not include them.
records.Tests: converter certification browser contract + Unix timestamp behavioural browser contract

records.DataSource: The PDF files the visitor selects; pages are copied with pdf-lib in the browser
records.KnownLimitations: Copies every page of each selected PDF into one document in the order shown, so the page count of the result is the sum of the inputs. Accepts at most 20 files and 50 MB in total; a larger selection is refused rather than truncated. A password-protected or damaged PDF is refused by name instead of being skipped silently. Form fields, annotations and digital signatures are not preserved: pdf-lib copies page content, so a signed input produces an unsigned output. Bookmarks and the document outline are dropped. Tagged-PDF structure is not carried over, so accessibility tags in the inputs are lost. The merge runs in the browser and the files are not uploaded to NovaTools.

records.DataSource: User-selected PDF; browser-local pdf-lib structural rewrite
records.KnownLimitations: Does not rasterize or downsample page images; output can be smaller, similar in size, or larger; maximum input is 50 MB and browser memory varies by device.
